create_ISet_singleton: create an ISet from a single integer element using ISet.singleton
create_ISet_interval: create an ISet representing a range of integers using ISet.interval
add_element_to_ISet: add an integer element to an existing ISet using the add method
merge_two_ISets: merge two ISet instances together using the merge method or in-place or operator
take_elements_from_ISet: split an ISet into two sets by taking the first N elements using take
